english: ...Is this really the right place, desuu?
The card's address says here...
Uu... no matter how you look at it,\nit's a run-down apartment with no sunlight, desuu...
But the nameplate says\nAyanokouji Detective Agency.\nAnd it reads 'Paranormal cases: all detective work accepted'...
// Remu arrives.
Oh? Already here? That was fast.
Ah, Remu!
Looks like fewer of you than before?
Yes. [NOEL] and Tsubasa\nsaid they'd make a detour, so\njust we two came ahead, desuu.
I see.
What cute kitty and doggy.
The cat's Alpha, the dog's Beta.\nCome on, you two, say hello?
Meow.
Woof!
Good kids, desuu!\nNice to meet you, ehehe!
Sorry we parted in a rush earlier.\nBut I got back to the office, contacted a detective I know,\nand got all sorts of info.
You know a police detective!?\nAmazing, desuu! Just like a real detective, desuu!
Um, didn't she say she WAS a detective...?
According to my detective contact, besides the\n'sudden street-sleeping phenomenon' case I'm investigating,\ntons of strange cases are happening.
Strange cases...? D-dangerous stuff?
First, the 'spirited-away' cases where\npeople suddenly vanish...
Tsubasa mentioned that too, desuu.\nScary, desuu...
Um, that includes us, right?
Yes. But there were still more.\nReaaally strange cases...
I-I'm getting scared, desuu...
First, the 'doppelganger phenomenon' cases where\na person looking exactly like you appears...
A-a ghost, desuu...?
Then the 'unknown lifeform attack' cases-\nclearly not lifeforms from Earth...
A-aliens!? Like,\nwith dogs' heads splitting wide open!?
And last, the cases of people\nclaiming 'I came from a world you don't know'\nappearing one after another...
Mysterious, desuu~!
Umm, so,\ndoesn't that include us...?
All of this happened\nin just a few days.\nNot normal, right?
Including the 'sudden street-sleeping phenomenon' case,\nI can't believe it's all coincidence.
Us ending up in this world\ntoo, desuu?
It's harder to think they're unrelated.\nWhich brings me to my proposal.
Will you help with my investigation?
Help, desuu?
Working with you, the ones involved,\nI think the investigation will go faster.
And I'll support you\nliving in this unfamiliar world.\nNot a bad deal, no?
That'd really help, desuu!\nUu, I've been so anxious, desuu.
Don't worry.\nI've got savings,\nand I can at least guarantee food, clothing, and shelter.
If we crack a big case,\nthere might even be reward money?
Understood, desuu! I'll do my best, desuu!
Then, sorry to rush, but\nlet's head out investigating!
Huh? Already, desuu!?
We're going to the 'sudden street-sleeping phenomenon' scene.\nYou two ready to head out?
S-so sudden...
It's fine, I can go, desuu!!
// Scene change\n// Background: town at night
Here's another one, desuu!
Good grief... that makes eight.
Zzz... zzz...
Suya... suya...
They're really asleep, desuu.
Eight people sleeping on the street\nby coincidence? Impossible.
Hmm...
Remu?\nDid you find something?
...Today,\nit's not just sleeping people.
Huh?
Look, over there.
There...?
Hyaaaaaaaah!?
N-n-n-no head...!!
Poor thing... did the killer\ntake the head with them, I wonder...
A brutal murder like this... I recall there was one in the past too...
Hawawah! Something came out, desuu!
A dream demon!?
Wh-when did it get here!?
They just keep coming, desuu!
We'll meet them head-on! But don't push yourself!
// Switch to battle map
D-do you think we'll manage...?
Yes. If things keep going like this.
Hm!?
Who's there!? Come out!
// Black Mion & Black Shion appear on the map
A-awawawawa, s-same face!?\nIt's the doppelganger thing, desuu!
Who are they...?\nThere are dream demons around-aren't they scared?
Weeell...\nshall we start today's club activities...?
I'll help, sis...
...No matter how you look at it,\nthose aren't friendly faces.
They're totally ready to kill, desuu!\nThat kind of vibe is NOT good, desuu~!!
// Battle resumes
Damn it...\nClub's over for today...
Let's go, sis...
// Black Mion & Black Shion vanish
Ah! They got away, desuu!
We can't chase them.\nThe sleepers' safety comes first right now.
...Good grief, nothing but mysteries.
// ■ After battle
// Background: town at night
Dream demons are handled for now.\nI wonder if there are any more sleepers?
I'll do one more round, desuu!\nI'll borrow the wake-up alarm!
// Meru leaves, off screen
Are the dream demons the ones putting people to sleep?
I don't think so.\nNot absolutely, but.
One reason: that headless corpse.\nThat's not how dream demons attack people.
Besides, if dream demons put people to sleep to attack them,\nnone of the sleepers would've gotten off unscathed.
True... there were people\njust sleeping, after all...
Still, too much is unknown.\nI'll leave questioning the sleepers\nto Inspector Sakaki...
Remuuu!\nCome over here, desuu~!
What is it?
This girl\nlooks like she's really suffering, desuu!
Uuu...
Can't we do something, desuu?
Maybe something's happening\nin this girl's dream world...
But right now, I...
Hm?
I'm sooo huuungry...
...Huh?
F-food...
Ah, so that's it...
// Scene change\n// Background: somewhere they can eat.
Puuhaaah!!\nThanks for the meeeal!!
She ate like three times what I did, desuu...
I could still eat more!!
First time I've seen someone eat this much.\nYou must've been starving.
Tahaha... ah, how embarrassing~.
But this is the first time in my life\nfood ever tasted this good.\nKuu, I could cry~.
Now, that's an exaggeration.
Well, actually, for about three days now,\nI haven't eaten a thing...
You really saved me!\nThank you so much!
If you want to thank someone,\nthank [MERU].\nShe's the one who found you.
Really!?\n[MERU]'s\nmy lifesaver~!
N-no, I just...\nwas trying to wake you, desuu...
No no!\nI nearly starved to death on the street!\nThank you SO much~!
Auu...
[MERU]'s\nshy with new people.\nGo easy on her.
Oops, my bad...
Th-that aside, what about YOU, desuu!\nWhy haven't you eaten\nin three days, desuu?
Well, a lot happened.\nHonestly, I don't know where to start...
Tell me anything.\nIt takes a lot to surprise me.
Really?\nThen... please don't think I'm weird\nfor suddenly saying this, but...
Actually, I'm not from this world!!
Huh... so that's how it is.
Huh? You're really not surprised?\nThen I'll continue.
During a certain job-not\na part-time one, though-\nmy vision suddenly went white.
When I came to, I was in a town I'd never seen.\nThis one, actually...
I couldn't exactly ask at a police box,\nand while wandering aimlessly,\nI got so hungry I couldn't walk...
I started thinking\nI might be cursed.
I get the gist.
You don't believe me, right?\nEven I think I'm saying\ncrazy things...
Then we might be cursed too...
Huh?
When your vision went white,\ndid you see a strange light?
Yes!\nHow did you know!?
These two are from another world too.
Whaaat!?
That's right, desuu.
A curse, I wonder...
So\nI believe you.\nUm...?
Ah! I haven't introduced myself!\nHibiki Tachibana! 15 years old!
Birthday September 13th, blood type O!\nHobby: helping people...
Ah, stop stop.\nThat's enough...
Huh, really?
Ah!? Don't tell me you're handing me to the police\nfor a thorough questioning over there!?
I wouldn't do that.\nJust asking, but\nyou don't know how to get back, right?
Yes, I... haven't a clue.
I'm trying to find out why\nyou all came to this world.\nIt'd help if you cooperated-what do you say?
Cooperation? I'll do cleaning, laundry,\nanything!\nI WILL repay you for the meal!
No need to be so desperate.\nThis is fate, after all.
Nice to meet you, Hibiki, desuu...
Yes! Likewise! Let's be friends!
Y-yes, desuu!
// END
